## Peptide Validation

The following barplot shows the intensities of the selected peptide across samples:

```{r}
#| label: peptide validation

KOPeptide <- metadata$Peptide[1]

has_KOPeptide <- length(KOPeptide) == 1 &&
  !is.na(KOPeptide) &&
  !(toupper(trimws(KOPeptide)) %in% c("", "-", "NA"))

if (has_KOPeptide) {

  df_KOPeptide <- df_norm_peptide %>%
    filter(toupper(`Protein.IDs`) == toupper(trimws(KOPeptide)))

  if (nrow(df_KOPeptide) > 0) {

    plot_df <- df_KOPeptide %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -`Protein.IDs`,
        names_to = "BioReplicate",
        values_to = "Abundance"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata %>% select(BioReplicate, Condition),
        by = "BioReplicate"
      )

    ggplot(
      plot_df,
      aes(
        x = BioReplicate,
        y = Abundance,
        fill = Condition
      )
    ) +
      geom_col() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Peptide selected:", toupper(KOPeptide)),
        x = "Sample",
        y = "Abundance"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      )

  } else {
    cat("KO peptide not found:", KOPeptide)
  }

} else {
  cat("No valid KO peptide selected (NA, '-', 'NA', or empty value)")
}
```
